plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, the 4-date timeline completes: 19 Sep 1966 (Thomas Brock and Hudson Freeze discover Thermus aquaticus in Yellowstone's 70 °C Mushroom Spring; Taq polymerase isolated in 1976) · Apr 1983 (Kary Mullis conceives the Polymerase Chain Reaction to double DNA 2^30 = 1.07 billion times) · 10 Sep 1984 (Alec Jeffreys in Leicester discovers DNA fingerprinting; exonerates Richard Buckland in 1986) · 29 Jan 1988 (Saiki, Mullis & colleagues combine Taq polymerase with PCR for automated single-tube amplification).

teach_overlay.detail: Animated 4-date timeline (19 Sep 1966 → 29 Jan 1988) alongside the single-cell PCR amplification and forensic exoneration diagram
teach_overlay.scale: a single free sample of pink bacteria lifted from a Yellowstone puddle in nineteen sixty-six now powers billions of diagnostic and forensic DNA tests around the globe every year
